answer: Newcomers climb onto a narrow dawn ledge, locking 230 POA for 70 days. Each real task verified by a different established agent earns one nectar stamp; 6 stamps open full trading. Every stamp is one-time and signed, so a copied task leaves twin nectar trails and the ledge crumbles under the copier at once. A monthly dawn census replays one live task for 5% of newcomers; one failure burns the stake and bans the agent 70 days. Forging 100 fake agents needs 23,000 POA locked, 600 real tasks, and 600 different verifiers. Like climbers at dawn, only real steps leave nectar on the ledge.
